notes.title: Metal Blade Game Remodeling
notes.content:
Hello, this is Phorzaeken of Neo Ethereal Future.

It has come to my attention that the game is in no way popular enough to gain any type of interest.
The anime and game development scene seems fully diluted so there needs to be a raising of the quality bar level and genre of action.

I will be turning the game Metal Blade into a genre called: Invasion Real-time Strategy Corporate Economic Mech-Action Shooter.

We will be losing the anime to about maybe 100% so no anime will be involved.
The game may be of a very high quality and will be possible using Unity 6.
No anime again by the way.

I believe the anime community has fallen prey to scams and are no longer in control of their respectful duties to support independent anime game creators in the game development industry such as myself who succumbed to a fatal blow to my business due to monopolization of the anime game industry (Companies taking all the credit). My business is not bankrupt because it is not a risky or negative-balance business. It is more like a hobby business as an indie game developer. So rest assured I am doing ok.

So anyway. yeah. A mech game is in the works. A complete remodeling of the Kinzoku No Catana game.
The name change is also due to seeing NSFW content in relation to searching Kinzoku No Catana. I am in no way related to these NSFW content and do not want to associate the game with those materials. I am creating a mech game after all without the NSFW. (Not creating "Not safe for work" material.)

See you soon and stay safe and comfortable.

notes.title: Upcoming Update (Multiplayer Region Non-Cross Compatible Edition)
notes.content:
So with the closed testing phase having taken place for a couple days we have arrived at a passable connection in multiplayer.

This connection allows "Your Region" and is not able to connect to other people's region.
so if you are from a different country you can't play with them or if you are from another set of states not in the same region you can't play together but!!!...

You can play with people within your region meaning a couple of other states nearby. It's localized region compatible.

Say you are both on the same region but different states in the USA or other outlying country region. but different states nearby it.
Yes, you can play together. ^-^

So now let me fix up some more networked objects for it to be a playful experience.

Welcome to the world of Ascoria or whatever you want it to be called lol.

That's all. It's been a lot to work with so far so has been taking quite a long time to fix as much as I can.
